name: mila-assistant
description: Mila, an assistant that runs local LLMs on your own GPU
author: Todd Thomson

scripts.prebuild:windows: node -e "['session/mila-session.exe', 'session/vcruntime140.dll'].every(require('node:fs').existsSync) || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.prebuild:linux: node -e "require('node:fs').existsSync('session/mila-session') || (console.error('No session to package: run cmake --install <build directory> --component mila-session --prefix session first.'), process.exit(1))"
